conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, their workdays could extend from sunrise to sunset during peak times.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: What kind of work did they do?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: They primarily focused on agriculture, building, and crafts.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I wonder what they did for fun after all that hard work?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
